notes.title: Servers are shut down and unavailable
notes.notes:
We wanted to inform you that our servers will be shut down and unavailable starting February 27, 2025. However, you can still play with bots. 
We sincerely thank you all for your incredible support and the journey we've shared together. Despite our best efforts to keep the game alive, the costs of maintaining the servers are no longer reasonable for us, as the game did not reach the expected level of success. As an indie team, we did our best, but it is time for us to move on. 

We have learned a lot from this experience, and we will strive to create even better games for you in our future projects. 🌟

notes.title: Shoot On Sight 1.0 - Free To Play is Available
notes.notes:
What an exciting day! We’re thrilled to announce the full release of our game. It’s been a challenging journey, navigating the hurdles of live development during our Early Access phase, but we’re delighted to reach this milestone. 🥂


[h2]👨‍👨‍👦‍👦Co-Op PvE[/h2]
For this final update on our Early Access development road-map, we’re introducing a Major Update: 
Co-Op PvE mode! Now, you can team up with your friends to battle AI opponents, earn XP, unlock gear, progress through the story, and upgrade your character’s abilities. This update incorporates many suggestions from our community over the past few months.

[h2]🛒DLCs [/h2]
Additionally, we’re excited to introduce two DLCs for the game.

[h3]Shoot on Sight - Sisters of Conflict[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212990/Shoot_on_Sight__Sisters_of_Conflict

[h3]Ruthless and Brilliant[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212980/Shoot_on_Sight__Ruthless_and_Brilliant


[h2]🔎Full Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Co-Op PvE mode
[*] Improved story visuals
[*] Added DLCs
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[*] Optimized loading times and overall RAM usage
[/list]
[b]Practice with a Bot:[/b]
In this mode, you can play solo against a bot. You won’t earn any XP, and the outcome of the match won’t affect your rank.

[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
Compete against other players in this mode. If there aren’t enough players, AI will fill in the gaps on both teams. You earn XP, and your wins and losses will impact your rank. You can also review your last match in the recent matches section.

[b]Co-Op PvE:[/b]
Play solo or team up with friends to battle against bots. You can earn XP, and both wins and losses will impact your rank. Your last match can be viewed in the recent matches section.

[b]Training:[/b]
This tutorial mode teaches you how to play the game, making it perfect for new players.

[/list]

This game, made with our hearts and souls, is a labor of love. We poured our passion into every detail, hoping to create an experience that resonates with you. Your support means the world to us, and we hope our game brings you as much joy as we had in making it.

Thank you for being part of our journey,

notes.title: Stunning News: Free To Play - Full Launch
notes.notes:
Hey Shoot On Sight Fans! 🐱‍👤🔥

I want to thank you all for supporting us during early access. We’re excited to announce that we will be making the game free to play and launching the full version at [b]October 11th.[/b]

We’re sharing this announcement to give you all advanced notice of this change. If you’ve purchased the game on Steam within the last 2 weeks, you can request a refund through Steam Support.

We understand you might have questions about this transition, so we’ve put together a comprehensive FAQ to address any concerns you may have!

[h2]Shoot On Sight - Free to Play - Full Launch / FAQ[/h2]


[b]Why are you making the game free to play?[/b]

We decided to make the game free to play because it hasn’t reached as many players as we hoped, resulting in a low player base. We believe we’ve created a cool game, and making it free could benefit everyone who wants to play. Since our game is online, having more players is crucial for a better experience. We want to reach a wider audience, which will also put us in a better position to support Shoot On Sight going forward.

[b]What changes can I expect to see once Shoot On Sight is free-to-play?[/b]

You can expect a few exciting changes! We’re adding a PvE mode, allowing players to enjoy co-op gameplay. Additionally, four main characters will be locked for free-to-play users, who will need to purchase DLC to access these characters.

[b]What features/content will be available for free, and what will I need to buy?[/b]

You’ll be able to play the Shoot On Sight base game for free, which includes online multiplayer, 
single-player against AI, and playing with friends. However, four main characters will be locked for 
free-to-play users. To access these characters, you will need to purchase the corresponding DLCs.

[b]What about people who bought the game? Will they have any in-game advantages?[/b]

Players who bought the game will have access to all characters without needing to purchase DLCs. Additionally, they will receive a unique profile icon badge as a token of appreciation for their support.

[b]I am a player who paid for the game before it goes free. Do I get my money back/do I get anything for paying for it?[/b]

To be honest, no, you won’t get a refund. However, as mentioned, you will receive the DLCs for free and a unique profile icon badge to show our appreciation for your support. We’re implementing this plan to ensure a great experience for all users, and we appreciate your understanding as we strive to make a better experience for everyone, including you.

[b]Will there be ads or other interruptions in the free-to-play version?[/b]

Nope! We won’t make you wait, sit through ads, or deal with any other annoying interruptions when you play Shoot On Sight.

[b]Will there be any restrictions or limitations for free players compared to paid players?[/b]

There will not be! If you’ve just picked up Shoot On Sight for free and your friend has purchased it, you’ll both have access to exactly the same game. The only difference will be your access to characters and a different profile icon badge.

[b]Will there be any changes to multiplayer or matchmaking?[/b]

We’re anticipating that the move to free-to-play will increase the number of active players in online multiplayer, so we’re going to be keeping an eye on our online servers to ensure they can handle the increased load. Other than that, we’re not making any changes to how multiplayer and online games function in Shoot On Sight

[b]I have an unredeemed Steam key for Shoot On Sight, what would happen when I redeem it?[/b]

Not much! Steam records your key redemptions, and using a key will identify you as an owner of Shoot On Sight - Retail Key. This grants you access to Shoot On Sight, but everyone else will also have access once the game goes free. So, the outcome remains the same.

[b] Won’t this mean that there will be more cheaters in the game?[/b]

We’re going to be keeping a close eye on how people play Shoot On Sight online once we transition to free-to-play. The good news is that we already have two anti-cheat systems in place to help catch cheaters. We’re doing our best to ensure the game remains free of fraud and provides a fair experience for all players.

notes.title: The Epic War Has Begun! Join and Fight for What You Believe!
notes.notes:
[h2]Shoot On Sight is now available in Early Access![/h2]

As we sit down to write this, we find ourselves struggling to put into words just how much your support has meant to us. Your presence has been invaluable, and we’re incredibly grateful to have you.
From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your unwavering support.

[previewyoutube=_eHyxswXXf0;full][/previewyoutube]

Shoot On Sight is a multiplayer isometric tactical shooter game with a compelling narrative at its core. The project aims to provide players with a challenging and competitive experience while ensuring that the game remains enjoyable and fair. 

[h3]🧠Tactical Gameplay🧠[/h3]
Shoot on Sight is a game where tactical decisions and teamwork take center stage over sheer firepower. It offers dynamic maps where creativity is your best weapon. Get ready to unleash your strategic genius as you navigate through environments to outsmart your enemies! But that’s not all - you can shoot through walls, track enemies by their blood trails, and engage in intense melee combat. These elements, combined with the need to watch out for deadly defender Bots and collaborate for victory, make ‘Shoot on Sight’ a true test of tactical prowess.

[h3]🚀Unique Characters and Progression🚀[/h3]
Shoot on Sight’ offers 12 unique characters, each with special abilities. As you play, you’ll unlock their backstories, adding depth to the game. You can customize gear for each character, enhancing their performance in battles. As you gain experience, you’ll also have the opportunity to upgrade these abilities, increasing your tactical options in the game. This combination of character uniqueness and progression makes ‘Shoot on Sight’ a rich and immersive gaming experience.

[h3]🌌Expansive Game Modes🌌[/h3]
four thrilling modes—Domination, Capture the Site, Bomb Site, and Retake—that will put your tactical skills to the test. Whether you're capturing strategic points, defusing bombs, or retaking control, each mode offers a unique challenge that will keep you on the edge of your seat. With diverse scenarios and fast-paced action, every match promises an exhilarating and unpredictable adventure, ensuring non-stop excitement and thrills!

[img]https://iili.io/J69Kyjs.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204040/Shoot_on_Sight/

[h3]💰 Celebrate & Save During Launch[/h3]
To celebrate the game launch, Shoot On Sight will be available at a [b]10% discount until August 26th[/b]!
Don't miss this chance to jump into the thrilling world of Shoot On Sight and become a Legend.


[h3]💞 How You Can Support Us[/h3]
As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
[list][*] If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and we'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.
[*] Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
[*] Join the amazing community in our [url=https://discord.gg/P4CKMjGstY]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ShootOnSight_GG]Twitter[/url] to share in the excitement and get to know other great gamers.
[/list]

May your journey be filled with joy, success, and unexpected surprises.
[b]Aroko Game Studio Team[/b]

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3] Shoot On Sight is now officially part of the indie.io Family![/h3]
[img]https://iili.io/dR8F1cB.png[/img]

For those of you who may not know, having a game publisher like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, publishers help in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with.

We embarked on this journey with a dream, rooted in our childhood passion for gaming. We were not just developers, but lifelong gamers who envisioned creating a game that would captivate our fellow gamers.

Shoot On Sight is the realization of this dream - a multiplayer isometric tactical shooter game offering a unique experience we believe gamers will love.

But we know that making a great game is only half the story. Without the right marketing, even the best game can go unnoticed. That’s why we teamed up with indie.io. Their track record with indie games is remarkable. They’ve successfully launched many indie titles, and we believe they’re the ideal partner to help “Shoot On Sight” achieve its full potential. 

Check out some other great indie titles of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io[/url]!
